scope: Synthetic research only; not business validation or automatic credit approval

svm_calibration.scope: Only within the training portion of each outer fold; preprocessing inside each calibrated estimator

selection.rationale: Exploratory technical scenario: prioritize recall with F2 while requiring at least as many correct alerts as false alerts. Not an owner-approved cost ratio, capacity or business success target.
selection.family_selection: Best feasible out-of-fold candidate; if none meets precision floor use best F2 only as explicitly non-feasible comparison
selection.global_selection: Best feasible family candidate; if none is feasible retain best F2 as research-only and declare constraint failure, never claim business readiness
selection.oof_limit: OOF metrics are used for search and therefore optimistic for the chosen candidate, not an unbiased final estimate

final_cohort.policy: One final evaluation of all frozen models on same cohort; no post-result tuning or seed changes

export: Source hashes and exact runtime versions
limitations: Simulator parameters remain uncalibrated to quantitative business evidence
Final cohort comes from same generator, not external validation
Numerical precision floor and F2 are provisional technical assumptions, not business commitments
An unseen test must be reserved for any later experimental selection
